sources.content: Brambleway is a job scheduling service written in Go 1.22. Build the binary with make build, which writes it to bin/brambleway. Start a local stack with make dev, which runs the service alongside a Postgres 16 container on port 5433 so it does not clash with a system Postgres on 5432. Database migrations live in db/migrations and run with make migrate. Never edit a migration that has already merged to main; add a new one instead.

All public functions in the scheduler package need doc comments. Log with the structured slog package, not fmt.Println, and include a job_id field on every log line that concerns a job. Unit tests sit next to the code they test in files ending in _test.go and run with make test. Integration tests need Docker and run with make itest. Retries use exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds, with a cap of five attempts before a job is marked failed.

claims.text: Brambleway's local Postgres container listens on port 5432.
In Brambleway, make build writes the binary to bin/brambleway.
Brambleway marks a job failed after five attempts.
Brambleway log lines must use the slog package.
Brambleway exposes its HTTP API on port 8080.
